errorCodes.meaning: No member with the supplied did exists.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

roleVac.description: Newly-minted role credential (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues. Omitted on an idempotent no-op.

vmc.description: Newly-minted membership credential carrying personhood false; omitted on an idempotent no-op.
